content:
Greetings, I am Robin Chen, a passionate freelance product designer and UX developer based in Taiwan, dedicated to crafting seamless and innovative digital experiences that bridge user needs with business goals.

My journey in product design and UX development began in 2017, fueled by a fascination with how design and technology intersect to shape user experiences.

I have 5+ years of working experiences in the relevant field, throughout my career, I've had the privilege of collaborating with diverse companies across multiple industries and countries to solve their problems and increase productivity.

My work revolves around simplifying complexity, turning intricate requirements into elegant and problem-solving solutions that enhance usability of products to boot the conversion rate and retention rate.

As a product designer, every project starts with understanding the "why" behind requirements and business objectives, through continuous communication with stakeholders, product managers, designers, and engineers to deliver expectation-meeting product.

As a UX developer, I have knowleges in full stack development, I speak both design and development languages, this allows me to create technically feasible and interactable high-fidelity minimum viable products, be a communication bridge between designers and devlopers.

I am open opportunity and looking forwarding to working with companies around the world.
